description: Several large plastic blocks in blue, yellow, white, red, and green sit on the bed in front of a pillow. The left hand hovers near the blue block to steady the area while the right hand picks up the red block and stacks it onto the yellow, then lifts the white block and presses it onto the blue base, adds the yellow-and-red stack on top, and finally places the green block onto the growing tower before letting go.
